name: Our Worth To God
overview: Scripture reveals that our worth to God is rooted in His intentional creation of humanity in His own image, affirming the intrinsic value of every person (Genesis 1:27). God’s intimate knowledge and careful formation of us, even in the womb, highlight how wonderfully made we are (Psalms 139:13-14). This worth is further demonstrated by God's precious love for us, willing to give up others for our sake (Isaiah 43:4), and His plans for our well-being and hope (Jeremiah 29:11). Jesus reminds us that life itself holds greater significance than material concerns, underscoring the value God places on our existence (Matthew 6:25).
